name: Edgegap MCP Server
description: Lets coding agents containerize, deploy, and troubleshoot multiplayer game servers on Edgegap, checking Dockerfiles, pushing images, deploying near players, and reading logs.

skills.name: Game Server Containerization
skills.description: Writes or checks a Dockerfile against Edgegap requirements and pushes the image to the Edgegap registry.

skills.name: Dedicated Server Deployment
skills.description: Creates an application and version, deploys close to players, and returns connection details.

skills.name: Deployment Troubleshooting
skills.description: Inspects app versions and deployment status and reads container logs to explain failed deployments.
